Class ScenarioCulturalSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioCulturalSectionBuilder
public class ScenarioCulturalSectionBuilder extends Object
Controller and UI builder for the N-dimensional Cultural Vector and Multi-Field Layers section of the Scenario Setup Panel.

Manages procedural stochastic generation via coupled Langevin-SDE formulas: \[ d\mathbf{C}_i = \alpha \nabla^2 \mathbf{C}_i \, dt + \sigma \, d\mathbf{W}_t \] as well as external raster (PNG, JPEG) and GIS (GeoJSON) cartographic layer imports.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
